deterministic_decision_rules: Fail closed when schema, taxonomy, policy, or sample shape is invalid.
Fail closed when any unknown field is present in a strict object.
Fail closed when any failure code is not present in the taxonomy.
Compute rejected when any blocking failure code is present.
Compute rejected when any critical score is below its accepted minimum threshold.
Compute accepted only when all critical scores meet thresholds and no blocking failure code is present.
Require declared decision to equal computed decision.
